If not, you won't see them come past your defenses!|[[Swamp Monster (Narrator)|Swamp Monster]] dialogue on Wave 5 ([[Foggy Forest]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ghost''' was the third enemy that appeared in the second and third night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had higher health and faster speed than all the enemies before it. It was also a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemy, so only a few towers could have dealt with them effectively early in the game. It was also immune to [[Splash Damage]] and [[Pyromancer]]'s burn damage. This enemy could have been very threatening to those unprepared. ==Appearance== The '''Ghost''' is a faceless, white, translucent enemy, which floats slightly above the ground. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in the [[Solar Eclipse Event]] is listed instead. *Cheap towers with high DPS and hidden detection, such as the [[Scout]], [[Crook Boss]] and [[Soldier]] are recommended against this. **For the [[Scout]], [[Crook Boss]] and [[Soldier]], you can use their {{Color|Golden}} skins for better performance. *As these spawn in hordes, you can place down a few Level 2 [[Gladiator]]s to quickly kill them. **The '''Ghosts''' are immune to [[Splash Damage]], so towers like the [[Mortar]] and [[Rocketeer]] are useless against this. ***The [[Swarmer]]'s ''Beehive Grenade'' ability will also not apply the stinging effect on them. *The [[Military Base]] is useless against this, as it cannot collide with the '''Ghost''' or detect it. *At Level 4+, the [[Ace Pilot]] is able to give towers in its range temporary hidden detection for 15 seconds, allowing towers without hidden detection to be able to attack the '''Ghost'''. **However, be aware that it is quite expensive to afford early on, when the '''Ghost''' first appears. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyGhost.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Executioner - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Ghost''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Solar Eclipse Trailer|'''Ghost''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyGhostIconIG.png|'''Ghost''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *In terms of appearance and immunities, the [[Ghost (Trick or Threat Town)|2020]] and the 2021 version of the '''Ghost''' are very similar. ==Update History== *'''6 December 2021''' -
